col_comments.material_cost_per_sku: Material Cost = RM Cost + PM Cost; approved per-SKU values.

col_comments.internal_material_conversion_cost_per_sk: Additional conversion expenses of approved internally manufactured source materials: upstream direct labour, production overhead, QC overhead and incremental stores overhead (including recursive earlier stages), scaled by BOM consumption per finished SKU. Zero if no eligible source lineage. Source-material RM value is already in RM Cost.

col_comments.prime_cost_per_sku: Prime Cost = Material Cost + Direct Labour + Internal Material Conversion Cost.

col_comments.manufacturing_cop_per_sku: Manufacturing COP = Prime Cost + Production Overhead + QC Overhead + Materials/Stores Overhead.

col_comments.internal_loaded_cost_per_sku: Internal Loaded Cost = Manufacturing COP + Administration Overhead + Finance Administration Overhead.

col_comments.pricing_cost_per_sku_ik: IK Pricing Cost = Internal Loaded Cost + canonical IK Marketing Expense.

col_comments.pricing_cost_per_sku_ok: OK Pricing Cost = Internal Loaded Cost + canonical OK Marketing Expense.

col_comments.ik_basic_price: IK Basic Price = IK MRP / (1 + GST % / 100).

col_comments.ok_basic_price: OK Basic Price = OK MRP / (1 + GST % / 100).

col_comments.ik_discount_amount: IK Discount Amount = governed IK discount adjustment from approved selling-price policy.

col_comments.ok_discount_amount: OK Discount Amount = governed OK discount adjustment from approved selling-price policy.

col_comments.ik_selling_price: IK Selling Price = IK Basic Price - IK Discount Amount (before scheme/contingency).

col_comments.ok_selling_price: OK Selling Price = OK Basic Price - OK Discount Amount (before scheme/contingency).

col_comments.ik_contingency_value: IK Contingency Value = IK Basic Price × Contingency % / 100 under frozen pricing snapshot.

col_comments.ok_contingency_value: OK Contingency Value = OK Basic Price × Contingency % / 100 under frozen pricing snapshot.

col_comments.ik_margin_amount_before_scheme: IK Margin Before Scheme = IK MRP - IK Pricing Cost (approved pre-scheme pricing bridge; not net-realisation profit).

col_comments.ik_margin_percent_before_scheme: IK Margin Before Scheme % = 100 × IK Margin Before Scheme / IK MRP. Not equivalent to proposed after-scheme Profit on MRP.

col_comments.ok_margin_amount_before_scheme: OK Margin Before Scheme = OK MRP - OK Pricing Cost (approved pre-scheme pricing bridge; not net-realisation profit).

col_comments.ok_margin_percent_before_scheme: OK Margin Before Scheme % = 100 × OK Margin Before Scheme / OK MRP. Not equivalent to proposed after-scheme Profit on MRP.

col_comments.price_list_ik: IK price-list membership from public.product_skus; TRUE=included, FALSE=excluded, NULL=source SKU membership not yet verified.

col_comments.price_list_ok: OK price-list membership from public.product_skus; TRUE=included, FALSE=excluded, NULL=source SKU membership not yet verified.

col_comments.refreshed_at_ist: Human-readable last refresh timestamp in Indian Standard Time (Asia/Kolkata), derived from exact refreshed_at UTC timestamp. Display-only, canonical audit timestamp remains refreshed_at.
